title: Equilibrium Position
description: Essential: Correctly solves for y_e by balancing vertical forces: QE(y_e) = Mg.

title: Force on Incline
description: Essential: Provides the correct expression for the net force along the incline, F(y) = (Mg - Qβ(y0 - y)) sin(α).

title: Oscillation Frequency
description: Essential: States the final oscillation frequency as f = (1/(2π))√(βQ/M).

title: SHM Recognition
description: Important: Identifies the net restoring force after leaving the incline is proportional to displacement, leading to SHM.

title: Effective Spring Constant
description: Important: Correctly derives the effective spring constant k = Qβ from the force expression.

title: Force Component Analysis
description: Important: Correctly resolves gravitational and electric forces into components parallel to the incline.

title: Sign Error in Force
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect sign for the electric force component or the net force on the incline.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional: Explicitly includes or checks units in the final expressions.
